versions.content: DRAFT When receiving a request for UDS Service RoutineCon- trol (0x31) with subfunction requestRoutineResults, if all verifications have been suc- cessfully done (see [SWS_Dcm_00568], [SWS_Dcm_00570], [SWS_Dcm_00571]) and DcmDspRoutineFncSignature is set to ROUTINE_FNC_PROXY , the Dcm mod- ule shall call the configured Xxx_RequestResults() function passing the routineCon- trolOptionRecord via (see [SWS_Dcm_01614]) and if Xxx_RequestResults() returned E_OK, reply the returned routineStatusRecord with a positive response.
